desc: Implement full solution: present-vs-isolated split, DSU over present values, multi-bucket union via anchor, count roots + isolated; verified both examples (outputs 4 and 2).
Verify complexity/perf: bucket build cost sum over present d of threshold/d ~ O(threshold log threshold), fine for threshold<=2e5; no O(n^2) or trial-division loops.
Confirm correctness reasoning: values > threshold always isolated (lcm >= max), anchor-union yields exactly the lcm<=threshold cliques, and repeated divisors in a bucket are harmless.
